get.description: Where you're signed in, most recently used first.

post.description: Choose a new password with a reset link. Signs out every device; log in after.

get.description:
Everyone the user can see, by name. `needs_details`: no "how we met" yet.
`recent`: people added to your own book in the last 30 days, newest first.

`search` matches names, how you met, work, tags, spaces and your own notes and
memory aids, ignoring case and accents.
The person's photo (WebP), for anyone who can see them.

post.description: Replace the photo. Any image the server can read; it's cropped to 4:5.

get.description: Parents, siblings, cousins, in-laws, …, from the links the user can see.

post.description: Take someone shared with you out of your book. Nobody else is affected.
Add someone you took out back to your book.
Undo a delete, within a minute of it.

get.description: The user's own notes on this person (empty if none).

put.description: Replace the user's notes on this person. Empty text removes them.

post.description: Put a person in a space. Adding someone who's already there does nothing.

get.description: People in this space that you took out of your book, to add back.
Stored links the user can see; `person` narrows to that person's links.

post.description: Mark a link as former (e.g. a divorce). Parent links never end.

The user's own timeline, newest first; `person` narrows to one person.
Who it's time to get in touch with. `today`: the user's own date (time zones).
The user's own setting (defaults when there is none yet), and when they're next due.
Birthdays of people you can see, from today to `days` ahead. Not your own.
One of your memory aids at random; `skip` the one just shown. 204 if you have none.

People, spaces, your memory aids and your notes matching `q`, a few of each.
